newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Italian firms to fund Romania power projects.
newsitem.headline: Italian firms to fund Romania power projects.

text.p: Italy's Italstrade and Carlo Gavazzi Impianti (CGI) intend to finance two Romanian hydroelectric projects worth a total $100 million, Romanian electricity authority Renel RA said on Thursday.
Renel spokesman Ion Eugeniu said an accord on the completion of feasibility studies for two plants of 30 and 25 megawatts had been concluded between Renel and the two companies.
"Afterwards, the three companies will link up in a joint venture to fulfil the projects," Eugeniu said.
The move is part of Renel's plans to attract foreign capital to Romania's power sector, a Renel statement said.
